documents.author: Contractor
documents.text: Existing deck will be demolished. Homeowner asked us to remove and dispose of demolished material, and we agreed disposal would be included.

documents.author: Homeowner
documents.text: Please include removal and disposal of all old deck debris as agreed.

documents.author: Estimator
documents.text: Scope: demolish existing deck, construct replacement deck and install railing. No disposal or debris haul-away item is listed.
